What is the transformer architecture?.answer: The transformer architecture is a deep learning model that uses self-attention mechanisms to process entire sequences in parallel. It consists of an encoder stack and a decoder stack, each built from layers of multi-head self-attention and feed-forward networks. Positional encodings are added to embeddings to convey sequence order information.

It provides a declarative way to specify constraints on LLM outputs and automatically enforce them using validators. What are common AI safety concerns with.answer: Common AI safety concerns with large language models include hallucination, toxicity, bias, PII leakage, and jailbreaking attacks. Hallucination is the generation of plausible-sounding but factually incorrect information, while toxicity involves producing offensive or harmful content. Bias occurs when models perpetuate societal prejudices, and PII leakage happens when they reproduce sensitive personal information.
